q2_gaps: epoch-style day numbering — "day 0 of Year 1" is a day-of-year ordinal with no month, but the Time vocabulary defines (Day <n>) as the day-of-month granularity (the worked example is "June 5, 2021"), and the seeded date-ordering rules read it as same-year-month day; nothing says how to record a day counted from an epoch, and (Day 0) is not a possible day-of-month

aspectual "begin" with a nominal eventuality object — "Every autumn equinox begins moth-season" has an event-denoting NP, not a to-V / V-ing complement, so the Inception rule (which assigns the begun activity Theme, plus Ongoing) is out of scope while the occurrence-object rule under Thematic roles gives Patient; the instruction set leaves the object's role undetermined between the two
review.notes: Compound decomposition is applied correctly throughout (genus for lantern_row/lantern_station/moth_season/autumn_equinox, noun modifiers left unexposed), the capitalized runs exceed their bare class words so name-hood plus a separate kind atom is right, and On/Along/Near are the entity-attached surface-preposition heads rather than LocatedIn. The "on the Cliff Path near the harbor" attachment is resolved to the station on a world-knowledge lean, which the single-reading default licenses.
